newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan shilling gains; trading in narrow bands.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan shilling gains; trading in narrow bands.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling gained marginally on Friday, commercial dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a mean shilling average of 55.48 from 55.49 on Thursday, while on the pound the shilling was posted at 93.57 from 93.28.
Commercial dealers said the shilling traded within a narrow bands amidst ample orders from importers and exporters.
"There were good volumes changing hands. Exporter sales came into the market, effectively taking the steam off the shilling drive," one dealer said.
The shilling opened at 55.45/50 levels with the dollar offer touching 55.48 at one point. A shilling rally against the dollar had continued unabated all week.
"As the weekend begins, players begin to square off their positions for the weekend. This should lend more support to the shilling," some dealers said.
